note: Online marketplace for artists' crafts and art (Guild.com), Madison WI. Merged into Ashford.com under an Agreement and Plan of Reorganization of 2001-01-03, closed in May 2001 (Ashford's 8-K of 2001-05-09: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1089909/000093066101500464/d8k.txt). Round not named.

Remote IT infrastructure and database management services, Mount Laurel NJ. Merged into a subsidiary of ANTs software in 2008 (ANTs' 8-K of 2008-06-03: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/796655/000115752308004800/a5698061.txt). Services are outside the focus taxonomy. Round not named.

Online marketplace for surplus business equipment (ZoneTrader.com). DoveBid bought its business for DoveBid stock under an Asset Purchase Agreement of 2002-02-27 and describes it as 'our acquisition of ZoneTrader, Inc.', continuing it as DoveBid Managed Services (DoveBid's S-1/A of 2002-08-12: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1108244/000101287002003402/ds1a.htm): acquired. Round not named.

Print procurement software and services (the merger of Noosh and Newline). A subsidiary of R.R. Donnelley by 2008 (exhibit 21 to RRD's 10-K of 2009-02-25, 'NewlineNoosh, Inc.', a Texas corporation: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/29669/000119312509037450/dex21.htm): acquired. City not established. Round not named.

Insurance claims and policy software (Castek Software Factory), Toronto. A subsidiary of Oracle by 2009 ('Castek Software Factory, Ltd.' in exhibit 21 to Oracle's 10-K of 2009-06-29: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1341439/000095012309018689/f52658exv21w01.htm): acquired. Round not named.
